name: object-so
description: 오브젝트(Object) 회사 소개 사이트 — 정적 HTML/CSS, KO·EN 다국어

scripts.check:links: echo 'See .github/workflows/check.yml — uses html-proofer in CI. For local: docker run -v $PWD/_site:/site klakegg/html-proofer /site --check-html --enforce-https'
scripts.check:json-ld: find ./_site -name '*.html' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'python3 -c "import re, json, sys; s=open(sys.argv[1]).read(); m=re.search(r\"<script type=.application/ld\\+json.>\\s*(\\{.*?\\})\\s*</script>\", s, re.S); json.loads(m.group(1)) if m else None; print(\"OK \" + sys.argv[1])" {}'
